name: High Chancel & The Solar Focus
act: Act IV: The Glass Cathedral in the Sky
description: Three meters above the nave on the Chancel dais, Factor Vane has cracked open the Stasis Coffin. The frost-crowned Monarch rises from the superfluid, aiming the great Astronomical Lens down into the valley to extinguish all biological heat.

cast.name: Factor Vane of House Kestrel
cast.description: Calibrating the lens gimbal to begin Beat 1 of the catastrophic extinction Cast.

cast.name: Hollis the Twice-Written
cast.description: Arrived with the 1588 customs ledger to stamp a Writ of Forfeiture and teleport the contraband back to the yard vault under Beat 6 rules.

cast.name: Pell the Written
cast.description: Taking the focal cue mark to speak the final lines authored in his book and cast the permanent summer road.

primitives.name: High Chancel Solar Focus Lens
primitives.stage_role: Focal Plane Cast Generator & Astronomical Lens
primitives.description: The civic instrument of the Mount: where intent is declared at the focal plane, and the room does not change, and the world is.

primitives.name: Cracked Stasis Coffin (Draining Superfluid)
primitives.stage_role: Draining Cryogenic Vessel on Chancel Dais
primitives.description: Borosilicate coffin hull cracked open on the chancel flagstones, superfluid pooling beneath the focal gimbal.

primitives.name: East Solarium Alignment Heliostat
primitives.description: High-altitude quartz mirror feeding concentrated solar flux into the primary chancel lens.
